meta.name: dispatching-parallel-agents
meta.description: Use when facing 2+ independent tasks that can be worked on without shared state or sequential dependencies

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 并行执行多个独立任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果同时有多个互不依赖的任务需要并行处理
copy.tagline_en: Execute multiple independent tasks in parallel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have multiple independent tasks that can be processed concurrently

howto.what: 当你有多个互不依赖的任务时，Claude 会为每个独立问题域创建一个子代理，让它们同时工作，最后汇总各代理的发现和修复结果。
howto.when: 当你遇到 3 个以上不同根因的测试失败、多个子系统独立故障，且各问题无需共享上下文时触发。

say.text: 同时排查工具审批竞态条件和批量完成行为的问题。
say.note: 每个代理专注于一个独立领域。

howto.what_en: When you have multiple independent tasks, Claude creates one sub-agent per problem domain, lets them work concurrently, and returns a summary of findings and fixes from each.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you have 3+ test failures with different root causes, multiple subsystems broken independently, and each problem can be understood without context from others.

say_en.text: Fix agent-tool-abort.test.ts and batch-completion-behavior.test.ts failures in parallel.
say_en.note: Two agents start investigating each file simultaneously.

say_en.text: Investigate tool approval race conditions and batch completion behavior concurrently.
say_en.note: Each agent focuses on one independent domain.
